title: The other-checkout guard does not read a harmless python heredoc body as shell
why: The other-checkout shell scan reads words inside a python heredoc body, so text that only quotes a path or a `cp` line is refused (triage's own refusals, Nov 7-8; step other-checkout-cp-own).
note: Fix: drop a python heredoc body from the shell scan only when the body parses and names none of os, subprocess, shutil, importlib, exec, eval or __import__. Review round 1 listed forms that must stay refused. The perl/ruby write gap (debt note other-checkout-perl-ruby-bodies) rides in the same follow-up. Built in lane other-checkout-cp-own (session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator, 03:14 CST Nov 8. Filed 03:16 CST Nov 8.
